subject.title: fix(gateway): bound session observer digest attempts and stop unpersistable loops

question: Should the Control UI session observer deliberately use at-most-once note digestion—retiring notes after failed or stale model attempts—or preserve a bounded retry path for transient failures?
rationale: Both choices prevent the reported runaway spend, but they differ in whether a user can lose a later observer summary for otherwise valid session activity; source-level correctness cannot determine that product reliability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept bounded at-most-once summaries
options.body: Keep retirement on every exit path and document that the observer may omit summaries after a failed attempt in exchange for a hard no-rebilling guarantee.

options.title: Add bounded retry semantics
options.body: Retain notes after transient model failures while consuming attempt budget and stopping retry scheduling once the budget is exhausted.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded at-most-once summaries
recommendation.body: Keep retirement on every exit path and document that the observer may omit summaries after a failed attempt in exchange for a hard no-rebilling guarantee.
